roast.TREND_MASTER: Riding the trend isn't a slogan for you, it's muscle memory. {days} days, {trades} closed trades, {win_rate} win rate. You wait for the move, then pounce. Most people never learn that patience.
roast.OVERTRADE: You trade like you're clocking in for a shift: {fills} fills over {days} days, {fpd} a day on average. The exchange sees you as its favorite VIP.
roast.KNIFE_CATCHER: The harder it dumps, the faster you buy. {trades} closed trades at a {win_rate} win rate, but falling knives don't play fair, and one bad catch stings for weeks.
roast.SCATTER_GUN: You're no sniper. You walk in with a drum mag and spray. {assets} assets, {fills} fills, {days} days, {fpd} fills a day. Every ticker gets a turn.
roast.PANIC_TRADER: The chart twitches, you bail, then it rips. {fills} fills full of feelings: a {win_rate} win rate, but you never held the ones that mattered.
roast.DIAMOND_HANDS: You buy and lie down. Up or down, you stay horizontal. {days} days, {trades} closed trades: peak calm, or you forgot your password.
roast.UNKNOWN: Not enough data for the AI to read you yet. {fills} fills so far. Trade a bit longer and come back.

card.roast_peak: On {peak_date} you fired off {peak} fills in one day. Is your keyboard okay?

verdict.S: {win_rate} win rate, {pf} win/loss ratio, and you barely ever get liquidated. You're not trading, you're collecting rent.
verdict.A: {win_rate} win rate, {pf} win/loss ratio. Solid. A little more aggression and S tier is in reach.
verdict.B: A {win_rate} win rate says you can pick entries. A {pf} win/loss ratio says you can't pick exits. Good bones; now cap the big losers.
verdict.C: {win_rate} win rate, {pf} win/loss ratio. Fading you might actually print. That's a talent too.
verdict.D: {win_rate} win rate, {pf} win/loss ratio. The market thanks you for the liquidity. Stop-losses next time, please.
verdict.F: {win_rate} win rate, {pf} win/loss ratio. Step away for a bit. A review is worth more than your next trade.
verdict.?: Not enough closed trades to rank you yet. Come back with more history.

rules.ALT_DC: No alt longs in a BTC death cross. You took {n} of them and won only {wr}.
rules.LIQ: Always set a stop on perps. {n} trades ended in liquidation; stop letting the liq price be your stop.
rules.COUNTER: Check the moving averages first. {pct} of your entries fought the trend; halve the size or skip it.
rules.LOW_PF: Cut losers faster than winners. Your win/loss ratio is {pf}; once a loss matches your average win, you're out.
rules.OVERTRADE: Set a daily trade limit. {fpd} fills a day, and the fees keep score.
rules.SCATTER: Less is more. You've traded {assets} assets; stick to the few you actually understand.
rules.WORST: Block {asset}. It's your worst asset; don't fall into the same hole a third time.
rules.JOURNAL: Write the reason before every entry. If you can't write one sentence, don't open it.
rules.SIZE: Keep your size fixed. Don't size up or down because of the last trade.
rules.REVIEW: Review once a month. Win rate and win/loss ratio don't lie.

questions.ALT_DC: Which way are the moving averages pointing? Am I riding the trend, or betting it turns?
questions.COUNTER: Which way are the moving averages pointing? Am I riding the trend, or betting it turns?
questions.LIQ: If this trade is wrong, do I exit at my stop, or at the liquidation price?
questions.LOW_PF: Am I still holding this loser because the thesis holds, or because I can't admit I'm wrong?
questions.OVERTRADE: Is this a real setup, or am I just bored?
questions.SCATTER: Do I actually understand this coin, or is it just green today?
questions.WORST: Am I jumping into the same hole again?
questions.DEFAULT: Can I explain in one sentence why I'm opening this trade?
